parameters.name: Description
parameters.description:
The description of the bastion host.

> The description must be up to 30 characters in length, and can contain letters, digits, underscores (\_), and hyphens (-).

parameters.name: InstanceId
parameters.description:
The ID of the bastion host.

> You can call the [DescribeInstances](~~153281~~) operation to query the ID of the bastion host.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description:
The region ID of the bastion host.

> For more information about the mapping between region IDs and region names, see [Regions and zones](~~40654~~).

example.unifiedCli: aliyun yundun-bastionhost modify-instance-attribute --instance-id bastionhost-cn-78v1gh0000 --description Bastionhost_demo --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --region cn-hangzhou
